name: Perp-spot basis discount + positive momentum — spot-led demand continuation (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why basis leads price): the perp-spot basis is the market's revealed price of leverage. When the basis goes NEGATIVE (perp trades at a discount to spot), the marginal buyer is in SPOT, not levered perps — a healthier, less reflexive bid that does not evaporate on a funding flip. Distinct from the basis-discount CONTRARIAN (which fades an oversold short-crowding extreme), this spec is CONTINUATION: it requires the discount AND positive ret_Nd, i.e. spot demand that is already lifting price. The basis is a high-frequency spot-perp spread so it flags the spot-led regime earlier than a realized-funding print. Exit when the basis flips back to premium (leverage chasing returns = froth). DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain positive-momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the basis discount adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: basis and funding are tightly coupled — if a funding-floor filter alone does as well, this is the funding spec re-skinned. Must clear ~20bps round-trip net.
catalyst: perp_spot_basis is in DISCOUNT (perp cheap to spot = spot buyers leading) while price momentum is already turning up.
